## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] WhatsApp behavior remains inbound-only.
- [ ] No customer messages, phone numbers, credentials, databases, QR codes, or local state are included.
- [ ] New logs and errors avoid exposing secrets or conversation content.
